title: Evening POS summary to the owner
summary: Every evening, add up today's Moniepoint POS sales from the POS sales table, per terminal, and tell the owner.
description: Every day at the time you choose, reads today's sales from your POS sales table (kept by the 'Record every Moniepoint POS sale' workflow), counts the approved ones, adds them up per terminal and per kind (card, transfer), notes the biggest sale and any payment that did not go through, and sends the owner a short message. Terminals are named from your terminals table when you have filled it in. The owner hears on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked to Taskiem, or by email.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the summary is sent, Lagos time.

params.name: table
params.title: POS sales table
params.description: The table the recording workflow writes to.

params.name: terminals_table
params.title: Terminals table
params.description: Your terminals and the names you call them.

tables.name: {{table}}
tables.title: POS sales
tables.description: Every transaction your terminals make, one row per event the provider sends. Amounts are in naira; fee and settled are filled when the provider reports them (OPay does, Moniepoint does not).

tables.name: {{terminals_table}}
tables.title: POS terminals
tables.description: Your terminals by serial number, with the name you call each one (Counter 1, Ikeja shop). Fill it in so summaries name terminals instead of serial numbers.

definition.name: Evening POS summary
definition.description: Adds up today's POS sales per terminal and tells the owner.

steps.name: Work out today's date in Lagos
Read today's sales from the POS sales table
Add up the day per terminal
Tell the owner today's POS takings

input.title: POS summary
input.message: =has(steps.totals.output.message) ? steps.totals.output.message : steps.settings.output.business_name + ' POS summary: today\'s sales could not be added up.'
